requirements: R1: The backup container must execute its initialization script successfully without permission denied errors, ensuring the system reaches a healthy state.

slices.title: Resolve backup script permission error on startup
slices.jtbd: When fixing container initialization for this epic, I want to ensure the backup script has the correct execution permissions, so that the service starts successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application environment is launched
When the backup container attempts to execute backup.sh
Then the script executes successfully without permission errors
And the overall system health check passes, confirming the fix.
